question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.**

The objective of Robotics **__are to interrogate__** smart machines that can help people in a variety of ways.
solution:
The correct answer is "is to develop."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The subject** "objective" **is singular, so we cannot use a plural heling verb **"are"** with it.
 
• So, options 3 and 4 can be ruled out.
 
• **Option 2: "Bully" **means to use your strength or power to hurt or frighten somebody who is weaker or to make him/her do something. (अपने से कमज़ोर को धमकाकर कोई कार्य करवाना; उस पर रोब जमाना)
 
 
• **Example**: *Don’t try **to bully**__ me into making a decision.*
 
 
 
• **Option 1:** **"Develop"** means to grow slowly, increase, or change into something else; to make somebody/something do this. (विकसित होना; विकास करना)
 __
 
• **Example**: *We need **to develop**__ this area.*
 
 
 
• So, it is better to opt for Option 1.
